patch.value: Track upstream pm-changelog release-tag reachability so queued deep snapshots do not drift against newer tags

The queued-snapshot race is not fixable in this repository alone: the deep run audits the main snapshot it was created with, but the changelog generator rebuilds full history from every release tag in the fetched repository (--all-release-tags), so any release tag pushed while a deep run waits for a local runner makes the committed changelog of the older snapshot look stale. pm-changelog currently has no option to scope release tag windows to tags reachable from the checkout's HEAD (checked against the pinned pm-changelog CLI options: --all-release-tags, --release-tag-pattern, --since-previous-tag, --until-release-tag; none restrict by reachability). Follow up upstream for a reachable-tags scoping option; once it exists, adopt it in the changelog:check invocation so the deep tier stops failing across releases.
